'''Polished Tuff''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from 2 × {{MCW|Polished Tuff Slab}}) and a [[Stonecutter]] recipe (from {{MCW|Polished Tuff Stairs}}). See {{MCW|Polished Tuff}} for everything else.
